title: 2026 14-Day Prayer Guide (Fast & Pray)
description: 14-Day Fast & Pray Devotional on the 5 core themes: To Pray, To Give, To Serve, To Disciple, and To Go.
creator: FGA

items.title: To Pray: Returning to God

devotional.author: FGA 2026 Fast & Pray
devotional.content:
The new year begins with an invitation to return to God. As we fast, distractions fade and our hearts become clearer. Returning is not about shame but about restoring closeness. God welcomes every step back with mercy, renewal, and joy. Today, let this journey begin with an honest, simple turning of your heart toward Him again.

### 🙏 Guided Prayer
> “Lord, I return to You today with an open heart. Draw me close and remove whatever has formed distance between us. Renew my desire for You and awaken my spirit to Your presence. Lead me into these days with humility, hunger, and trust in Your love. I surrender this new year to You. Amen.”

### 🕊️ Being With God
- Take a slow breath and settle into silence.
- Pray: “Jesus, I return to You.”
- Remain still for a moment, letting His peace rest on you before you move on.

### ✨ Daily Blessing
> *"May the Lord draw you close today, renew your heart, and fill you with peace as you return to Him."*

reflect: Lord, what are You inviting me to return to this year?
Where does my heart need renewal?
What step of obedience or surrender are You revealing?
practice: Ask God to soften your heart and renew a hunger for His presence.
Surrender anything that has distracted you spiritually.
Invite the Holy Spirit to reveal what He wants to restore.

items.title: To Pray: Hearing God’s Voice

devotional.author: FGA 2026 Fast & Pray
devotional.content:
God desires to speak more often than we expect. His voice comes with peace, clarity, and conviction. Fasting quiets our inner world so we can hear Him more clearly. As you slow down today, trust that the Shepherd knows how to communicate with His sheep. Tune your heart to His guidance and expect Him to lead you gently and faithfully.

### 🙏 Guided Prayer
> “Lord Jesus, open my heart and ears to recognise Your voice today. Silence distractions and help me discern Your leading with clarity and peace. Teach me to follow Your gentle nudges and trust Your wisdom. Let this day deepen my confidence in hearing You more personally and consistently. Lead me step by step. Amen.”

### 🕊️ Being With God
- Settle into stillness and breathe in slowly.
- Pray: “Speak, Lord. I am listening.”
- Remain quiet, allowing His presence to calm your heart.

### ✨ Daily Blessing
> *"May the Lord open your ears to His voice and guide your steps in peace."*

reflect: Lord, what are You speaking to me today?
Where are You leading me to trust You more deeply?
What truth do I need to hold onto?
practice: Ask God to clear inner noise and distractions.
Pray for discernment for important decisions in 2026.
Ask the Spirit to train your heart to recognise God’s voice.

items.title: To Pray: Aligning With God’s Will

devotional.author: FGA 2026 Fast & Pray
devotional.content:
Prayer aligns our desires with God’s heart. Jesus teaches us to seek the Father’s will above our own, trusting that His plans are wise and full of love. As you fast, invite God to reshape your priorities and decisions. Alignment allows you to walk confidently, knowing you’re stepping into His purposes for 2026.

### 🙏 Guided Prayer
> “Father, align my heart with Your will today. Remove any desire that pulls me from Your path and shape my thoughts according to Your wisdom. Give me clarity to recognise Your direction and courage to obey it. Let this year be marked by choices that honour You. Lead my steps into Your purposes. Amen.”

### 🕊️ Being With God
- Take a deep breath and open your hands as a sign of surrender.
- Pray: “Your will be done in me.”
- Sit quietly, trusting Him to lead you gently.

### ✨ Daily Blessing
> *"May God guide your desires and establish His will in your life today."*

reflect: Lord, what part of my will needs surrender?
Where are You inviting me to trust Your direction?
What act of obedience are You highlighting?
practice: Surrender your plans for 2026 to God’s leadership.
Pray for desires shaped by God’s character.
Ask for joy in obeying God’s will.

items.title: To Give: Receiving God’s Generosity First

devotional.author: FGA 2026 Fast & Pray
devotional.content:
Generosity begins with receiving. When we recognise God as the Giver of every good gift, our hearts overflow with gratitude. Fasting slows us down long enough to appreciate His kindness. Today, reflect on how God has provided, protected, and blessed you. Gratitude softens the heart and prepares us to give freely and joyfully.

### 🙏 Guided Prayer
> “Lord, thank You for every gift You’ve placed in my life. Remind me of Your goodness and open my eyes to see Your blessings clearly. Let gratitude shape my attitude and actions. Teach me to reflect Your generosity in the way I give and live today. I offer my heart with thankfulness. Amen.”

### 🕊️ Being With God
- Take a slow breath and reflect on God’s goodness this year.
- Pray: “Thank You, Lord, for Your gifts.”
- Remain still, allowing gratitude to fill your heart.

### ✨ Daily Blessing
> *"May gratitude overflow from your heart and generosity flow from your life."*

reflect: Lord, what blessings are You reminding me of?
Who needs generosity from me this week?
Where are You calling me to give freely?
practice: Thank God for His provision and care.
Ask for a heart sensitive to others’ needs.
Pray for joy in giving.

items.title: To Give: Living With Open Hands

devotional.author: FGA 2026 Fast & Pray
devotional.content:
Living with open hands means trusting God as our provider. We release the need to control and instead embrace freedom, generosity, and faith. Fasting loosens our grip on what we hold too tightly. Today, ask God to teach you the joy of giving without fear, trusting that He enriches us so we can enrich others.

### 🙏 Guided Prayer
> “Lord, teach me to live with open hands today. Replace fear with trust and help me see giving as an act of worship. Free me from anything that makes me hold on too tightly. Let my generosity reflect Your heart and bring encouragement to someone who needs it. Guide my steps in kindness. Amen.”

### 🕊️ Being With God
- Pause and notice any tension in your heart or mind.
- Pray: “I open my hands to You, Lord.”
- Sit quietly, letting trust replace worry.

### ✨ Daily Blessing
> *"May your hands be open and your heart filled with God’s generosity."*

reflect: Lord, what am I clinging to too tightly?
Where do You want me to trust You more deeply?
Who needs generosity from me today?
practice: Ask God to break fear of lack.
Pray for opportunities to give joyfully.
Ask for trust in God’s provision.

items.title: To Give: Offering Yourself to God

devotional.author: FGA 2026 Fast & Pray
devotional.content:
God desires more than our resources—He desires our whole selves. Offering ourselves to Him is an act of worship. Fasting reminds us that our lives, abilities, and decisions belong to God. Today, offer your time, skills, habits, and plans to Him anew. A surrendered life becomes a powerful instrument in God’s hands.

### 🙏 Guided Prayer
> “Lord, I offer myself to You today—my heart, abilities, habits, and decisions. Shape my life into something that brings You joy. Help me surrender my daily routines and long-term plans. Use me in ways that honour You and bless others. I place my whole life on Your altar with trust and gratitude. Amen.”

### 🕊️ Being With God
- Slow your breathing and place your hands over your heart.
- Pray: “Here I am, Lord.”
- Remain quiet, offering yourself to God in stillness.

### ✨ Daily Blessing
> *"May your life be a living sacrifice, holy and pleasing to God."*

reflect: Lord, what area of my life needs fresh surrender?
Where do You want to use me?
How can I honour You in my routines?
practice: Offer your daily life to God.
Offer your skills and abilities to His service.
Ask for a life marked by worship.

items.title: To Serve: Following Jesus’ Humility

devotional.author: FGA 2026 Fast & Pray
devotional.content:
Service begins with humility—the willingness to place others before ourselves. Jesus modelled a life of compassion, sacrifice, and quiet strength. As you fast today, ask God to form a servant-hearted spirit within you. Serving doesn’t require grand actions; it begins with small, unseen moments where love becomes visible.

### 🙏 Guided Prayer
> “Jesus, make my heart like Yours. Teach me humility that serves without seeking recognition. Help me see others through Your compassionate eyes. Show me practical ways to bless someone today. Let my actions reflect Your character and bring encouragement to those around me. Shape my heart into a servant’s heart. Amen.”

### 🕊️ Being With God
- Take a moment to breathe slowly and release your need to be seen.
- Pray: “Make me more like You, Jesus.”
- Rest in His gentle humility.

### ✨ Daily Blessing
> *"May the humility of Christ shape your words, actions, and heart today."*

reflect: Lord, whom do You want me to serve today?
Where do I need more humility?
What small act of service can I offer?
practice: Pray for humility.
Ask whom you can serve today.
Pray to serve without recognition.

items.title: To Serve: Loving People in Action

devotional.author: FGA 2026 Fast & Pray
devotional.content:
Love becomes real through action. Genuine service flows from compassion and willingness. Fasting quiets self-focus and awakens love for people who need encouragement, support, or kindness. Today, ask God to help you notice the people around you—those who need a gentle word, a listening ear, or a simple act of care.

### 🙏 Guided Prayer
> “Lord, fill my heart with Your love so that I may serve others with sincerity and compassion. Help me see the needs around me and respond with gentleness and kindness. Let my actions reflect Your heart and bring comfort to someone who feels unseen today. Teach me to love through simple actions. Amen.”

### 🕊️ Being With God
- Pause and let your heart soften toward people in your life.
- Pray: “Fill my heart with Your love.”
- Sit quietly, letting compassion grow within you.

### ✨ Daily Blessing
> *"May love overflow from your life through humble, gentle actions."*

reflect: Who needs loving action from me today?
What simple act of kindness can I offer?
How can I bring Your love into my relationships?
practice: Pray for compassion for someone in need.
Ask for strength to serve joyfully.
Pray to notice opportunities to love others in action.

items.title: To Serve: Using Your Gifts Faithfully

devotional.author: FGA 2026 Fast & Pray
devotional.content:
God has given every believer gifts meant to bless others. Serving with our gifts strengthens the church and brings joy to the heart. Fasting can clarify where God is calling you to step in, serve, or grow. Today, ask God to highlight your gifts and show you where they can make a difference this year.

### 🙏 Guided Prayer
> “Lord, thank You for the gifts You’ve entrusted to me. Reveal where You want me to use them this year. Help me serve with faithfulness, humility, and joy. Give me courage to step into new opportunities and strengthen what You’ve placed in me. Let my gifts bring blessing and encouragement to others. Amen.”

### 🕊️ Being With God
- Slow your breathing and reflect on what God has entrusted to you.
- Pray: “Use my gifts for Your kingdom.”
- Rest, letting confidence replace self-doubt.

### ✨ Daily Blessing
> *"May your gifts shine for God’s glory and bless many today."*

reflect: What gifts have You given me to use this year?
Where are You calling me to serve?
Who needs what You’ve placed in me?
practice: Thank God for your gifts.
Ask God where He wants you to serve.
Pray for courage to use your gifts boldly.

items.title: To Disciple: Growing in Christlikeness

devotional.author: FGA 2026 Fast & Pray
devotional.content:
Discipleship is a lifelong journey of becoming more like Jesus. Growth happens when we stay rooted in His Word, presence, and Spirit. Fasting deepens our dependence on God and renews our desire for spiritual maturity. Today, ask God to strengthen your roots and shape your character in ways that reflect Christ more fully.

### 🙏 Guided Prayer
> “Lord, root my life deeply in You. Strengthen my faith and shape my character into the likeness of Christ. Help me grow in humility, compassion, and obedience. Nourish my spirit through Your Word and presence. Let this year be marked by steady, meaningful growth as I walk closely with You. Transform me from within. Amen.”

### 🕊️ Being With God
- Take a slow breath and imagine your roots deepening in God’s love.
- Pray: “Root me in You, Lord.”
- Stay still, allowing Him to steady your heart.

### ✨ Daily Blessing
> *"May Christ strengthen your roots and grow His character within you today."*

reflect: Lord, where do You want me to grow?
What unhealthy patterns need surrender?
What habits strengthen my walk with You?
practice: Pray for deeper spiritual roots.
Ask God to grow Christlike character in you.
Pray for strength in areas of weakness.

items.title: To Disciple: Walking With Others

devotional.author: FGA 2026 Fast & Pray
devotional.content:
Discipleship flourishes in community. We grow stronger when we encourage, sharpen, and support one another. Fasting softens our hearts toward others and awakens our need for spiritual friendships. Today, ask God to lead you into deeper relationships where you can grow, receive encouragement, and walk with others in faith, humility, and unity.

### 🙏 Guided Prayer
> “Lord, thank You for the gift of community. Teach me to walk with others in love, humility, and encouragement. Show me whom I can support and who can walk alongside me this year. Strengthen my relationships and deepen my connections in the church. Help me build others up with grace and truth. Amen.”

### 🕊️ Being With God
- Pause and picture those God has placed in your life.
- Pray: “Give me a heart for Your people, Lord.”
- Sit quietly, letting gratitude grow.

### ✨ Daily Blessing
> *"May God surround you with community that strengthens your faith."*

reflect: Lord, who are You inviting me to walk with this year?
How can I strengthen my small group relationships?
Who needs encouragement from me today?
practice: Pray for deeper, meaningful relationships.
Ask God whom you can encourage today.
Pray for a humble and teachable heart.

items.title: To Disciple: Teaching Obedience

devotional.author: FGA 2026 Fast & Pray
devotional.content:
Helping others follow Jesus is a core part of discipleship. We aren’t called to make admirers, but obedient followers. Fasting helps sharpen our example and renew our commitment to living out Scripture with integrity. Today, ask God to shape you into someone who teaches obedience by your life, words, and walk with Christ.

### 🙏 Guided Prayer
> “Lord, shape my life so that it leads others toward obedience. Give me wisdom to guide gently and humility to teach by example. Show me who You want me to walk with and help me live in a way that honours You. Strengthen my obedience so I can help others follow You faithfully. Amen.”

### 🕊️ Being With God
- Quiet your heart and bring someone to mind.
- Pray: “Lead me as I lead others.”
- Remain still, letting God form a gentle spirit in you.

### ✨ Daily Blessing
> *"May you walk in obedience and help others follow Jesus with joy."*

reflect: Lord, who are You calling me to disciple?
How can I model obedience this year?
What truth should I pass on?
practice: Pray for someone God may want you to disciple.
Ask for wisdom to teach and model obedience.
Pray for obedience in your own life.

items.title: To Go: Seeing the Harvest

devotional.author: FGA 2026 Fast & Pray
devotional.content:
God is already working in the hearts of people around you. Fasting sharpens our spiritual sight so we don’t miss His activity. Today, ask God to open your eyes to opportunities for love, witness, and compassion. The harvest is not something we create—it’s something we join. Lift your eyes and see where God is moving.

### 🙏 Guided Prayer
> “Lord, open my eyes to the people You’ve placed around me. Show me where You are already at work. Give me compassion for the hurting and courage to respond with love. Help me recognise divine opportunities and step into them faithfully. Lead me into the harvest with Your heart and wisdom today. Amen.”

### 🕊️ Being With God
- Pause and imagine Jesus looking at your neighbourhood with compassion.
- Pray: “Open my eyes, Lord.”
- Sit quietly, letting His burden become yours.

### ✨ Daily Blessing
> *"May God open your eyes to His work and your heart to His mission."*

reflect: Lord, who around me is open to Your love?
Where are You already working?
What step of faith can I take today?
practice: Pray for people far from God.
Ask for open doors for conversations.
Pray for courage for small steps of faith.

items.title: To Go: Sent With God’s Presence

devotional.author: FGA 2026 Fast & Pray
devotional.content:
You are not entering 2026 alone—Jesus sends you with His presence, authority, and peace. These 14 days prepare your heart to live as someone commissioned by God. Today, embrace your role as His ambassador. Wherever you go, He goes with you. Step into the new year assured that you are sent with purpose.

### 🙏 Guided Prayer
> “Jesus, thank You for sending me into this year with Your presence and strength. Give me courage to live out my calling and represent You with love. Fill me with Your Spirit and guide me into Your purposes. Send me where I can bring hope, light, and compassion. Use my life for Your glory. Amen.”

### 🕊️ Being With God
- Take a slow breath and imagine Jesus placing His hand on your shoulder.
- Pray: “Here am I, send me.”
- Sit in quiet confidence, receiving His commissioning.

### ✨ Daily Blessing
> *"May the Lord send you in His strength, surround you with His presence, and use you mightily in 2026."*

reflect: Lord, where are You sending me this year?
What mission are You giving me?
Who do You want me to love intentionally?
practice: Pray for boldness to live as God’s ambassador.
Ask God to guide your steps for 2026.
Pray for opportunities to share Christ’s love.
